(async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ApexArrow]";


const ANIM_KEY = "oni.apexArrow";


const ACTION_NAME = "Zero Power: Apex Arrow";


const CUTIN_PROP_PATH = "system.props.cut_in_zero_power";


const CFG = {


// Jump / motion


jumpTargetX: 645,


jumpTargetY: 76,


jumpMs: 650,


jumpArcPx: 220,


spinTurns: 1.5,


afterimageIntervalMs: 35,


afterimageFadeMs: 220,


afterimageScaleBoost: 0.06,


// Layering


blackZ: 95000,


afterimageZ: 95005,


spriteZ: 95010,


vfxZ: 95020,


cutinZ: 98000,


whiteZ: 999999,


// Cut-in tuning


cutinSlideInMs: 500,


cutinHoldMs: 700,


cutinSlideOutMs: 500,


cutinPortraitHeightRatio: 0.92,


cutinPortraitInsetX: 220,


cutinPortraitBottomMargin: 40,


cutinPortraitYOffset: -130,


cutinFlashPeak: 0.92,


cutinFlashDelayMs: 50,


cutinFlashInMs: 70,


cutinFlashOutMs: 170,


// Main VFX

vfxFile: "modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/05-spell/homebrew/fire/EmberGaze_Ray_1_YELLOW_RANGE_30ft_1600x400.webm",

vfxScale: 2,

vfxOffsetX: 0,

vfxOffsetY: 0,

vfxRotationDeg: 45,

vfxTtlMs: 1000,


// SFX

cutinSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav",

cutinSfxVolume: 0.9,

vfxSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav",

vfxSfxVolume: 0.9,


// Whiteout


whiteoutInMs: 1800,


whiteoutOutMs: 650,


totalTimeoutMs: 20000


};


const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (!ONI.emit) {


ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


function asTokenPlaceable(doc) {


if (!doc) return null;


if (doc.object) return doc.object;


if (doc.token?.object) return doc.token.object;


if (doc.documentName === "Token") return canvas.tokens?.get(doc.id) ?? null;


if (doc.documentName === "Actor") {


return canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.actor?.id === doc.id) ?? null;


}


return null;


}


async function fromUuidSafe(uuid) {


if (!uuid) return null;


try {


return await fromUuid(uuid);


} catch (err) {


console.warn(TAG, "fromUuid failed", uuid, err);


return null;


}


}


async function resolveSourceToken() {


const candidates = [


P.attackerUuid,


P.sourceTokenUuid,


P.casterTokenUuid,


P.sourceUuid,


P.tokenUuid,


P.actorUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const uuid of candidates) {


const doc = await fromUuidSafe(uuid);


const token = asTokenPlaceable(doc);


if (token) return token;


}


return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;


}


async function resolveTargets() {


const raw = [];


const maybeArrays = [


P.targets,


P.targetTokenUuids,


P.originalTargetUUIDs,


P?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs


];


for (const arr of maybeArrays) {


if (Array.isArray(arr)) raw.push(...arr);


}


const out = [];


for (const uuid of raw) {


const doc = await fromUuidSafe(uuid);


const token = asTokenPlaceable(doc);


if (token) out.push(token);


}


return out;


}


function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs = 15000) {


return new Promise((resolve) => {


let settled = false;


const timer = setTimeout(() => {


if (settled) return;


settled = true;


Hooks.off(hookName, handler);


console.warn(TAG, "Timed out waiting for hook", hookName);


resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true });


}, timeoutMs);


const handler = (data) => {


if (settled) return;


settled = true;


clearTimeout(timer);


Hooks.off(hookName, handler);


resolve(data ?? { ok: true });


};


Hooks.on(hookName, handler);


});


}


const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();


const targets = await resolveTargets();


if (!sourceToken) {


ui.notifications.warn("Apex Arrow animation: no caster token found.");


return;


}


if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


ui.notifications.error("Apex Arrow animation: ONI Pseudo API not found.");


return;


}


const cutinUrl = foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken.actor, CUTIN_PROP_PATH) ?? "";


const doneHook = `${ANIM_KEY}.done.${randomID()}`;


const payloadForEmit = {


type: ANIM_KEY,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,


targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


};


const scriptSource = String.raw`


const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error('Apex Arrow pseudo script: missing casterToken');


const cfg = Object.assign({


jumpTargetX: 645,


jumpTargetY: 76,


jumpMs: 650,


jumpArcPx: 220,


spinTurns: 1.5,


afterimageIntervalMs: 35,


afterimageFadeMs: 220,


afterimageScaleBoost: 0.06,


blackZ: 95000,


afterimageZ: 95005,


spriteZ: 95010,


vfxZ: 95020,


cutinZ: 98000,


whiteZ: 999999,


cutinSlideInMs: 500,


cutinHoldMs: 700,


cutinSlideOutMs: 500,


cutinPortraitHeightRatio: 0.92,


cutinPortraitInsetX: 220,


cutinPortraitBottomMargin: 40,


cutinPortraitYOffset: -130,


cutinFlashPeak: 0.92,


cutinFlashDelayMs: 50,


cutinFlashInMs: 70,


cutinFlashOutMs: 170,


  vfxScale: 2,

  vfxOffsetX: 0,

  vfxOffsetY: 0,

  vfxRotationDeg: 45,

  vfxTtlMs: 1000,

  whiteoutInMs: 1800,

  whiteoutOutMs: 650,

  cutinSfxVolume: 0.9,

  vfxSfxVolume: 0.9

}, params.cfg ?? {});


const loadTex = globalThis.loadTextureSafe ?? loadTexture;


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Number(ms) || 0));


const degToRad = (deg) => (Number(deg) || 0) * (Math.PI / 180);


const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;


const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);


function safeRemove(obj) {


try {


if (obj?.parent) obj.parent.removeChild(obj);


} catch (_) {}


}


function safeDestroy(obj) {


try {


obj?.destroy?.();


} catch (_) {}


}


function applyDisplaySizeAndFlip(sprite, baseObj) {


const texW = sprite.texture?.width || 1;


const texH = sprite.texture?.height || 1;


const dispW = Math.abs(Number(baseObj?.width) || texW);


const dispH = Math.abs(Number(baseObj?.height) || texH);


const flipX = Math.sign(Number(baseObj?.scale?.x) || 1) || 1;


const flipY = Math.sign(Number(baseObj?.scale?.y) || 1) || 1;


sprite.scale.set((dispW / texW) * flipX, (dispH / texH) * flipY);


}


function resolveLandingFacingSign(firstTarget, startX, endX, currentScaleX) {

  const currentSign = Math.sign(Number(currentScaleX) || 1) || 1;

  if (!firstTarget) return currentSign;


  const homeSide = Math.sign((firstTarget.center?.x ?? startX) - startX) || 0;

  const landingSide = Math.sign((firstTarget.center?.x ?? endX) - endX) || 0;


  if (homeSide === 0 || landingSide === 0) return currentSign;


  return homeSide === landingSide ? currentSign : -currentSign;

}


function addStageChild(obj, z) {


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


obj.zIndex = Number(z) || 0;


canvas.stage.addChild(obj);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


return obj;


}


function tweenValue(onUpdate, from, to, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const duration = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / duration;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = easeFn(t);


onUpdate(lerp(from, to, e), t, e);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


function fadeAlpha(obj, from, to, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic) {


obj.alpha = from;


return tweenValue(v => { obj.alpha = v; }, from, to, durMs, easeFn);


}


function tweenXY(obj, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic, onStep = null) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const duration = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / duration;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = easeFn(t);


obj.x = lerp(fromX, toX, e);


obj.y = lerp(fromY, toY, e);


if (onStep) onStep({ t, e, rawX: lerp(fromX, toX, t), rawY: lerp(fromY, toY, t) });


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function createCasterClone(token) {


const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;


const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTex(token.document.texture.src);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = token.center.x;


sprite.y = token.center.y;


applyDisplaySizeAndFlip(sprite, baseObj);


sprite.rotation = Number(baseObj?.rotation) || 0;


sprite.alpha = 1;


return sprite;


}


function spawnAfterimageFrom(sourceSprite, layer) {


const img = new PIXI.Sprite(sourceSprite.texture);


img.anchor.set(sourceSprite.anchor.x, sourceSprite.anchor.y);


img.x = sourceSprite.x;


img.y = sourceSprite.y;


img.rotation = sourceSprite.rotation;


img.scale.set(sourceSprite.scale.x, sourceSprite.scale.y);


img.alpha = 0.55;


layer.addChild(img);


void Promise.all([


fadeAlpha(img, img.alpha, 0, cfg.afterimageFadeMs, easeOutCubic),


tweenValue(v => {


const signX = Math.sign(sourceSprite.scale.x) || 1;


const signY = Math.sign(sourceSprite.scale.y) || 1;


img.scale.set(


signX * (Math.abs(sourceSprite.scale.x) + v),


signY * (Math.abs(sourceSprite.scale.y) + v)


);


}, 0, Number(cfg.afterimageScaleBoost) || 0, cfg.afterimageFadeMs, easeOutCubic)


]).finally(() => {


safeRemove(img);


safeDestroy(img);


});


}


async function playCutIn(url) {


if (!url) return;


const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;


const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


const overlay = addStageChild(new PIXI.Container(), cfg.cutinZ);


overlay.sortableChildren = true;


const flash = new PIXI.Graphics();


flash.beginFill(0xFFFFFF, 1);


flash.drawRect(0, 0, W, H);


flash.endFill();


flash.alpha = 0;


flash.zIndex = 2;


overlay.addChild(flash);


const portraitTex = await loadTex(url);


const portrait = new PIXI.Sprite(portraitTex);


portrait.anchor.set(0, 1);


portrait.zIndex = 3;


portrait.scale.set((H * Number(cfg.cutinPortraitHeightRatio || 0.92)) / (portrait.texture?.height || 1));


portrait.x = -portrait.width - 80;


portrait.y = (H - Number(cfg.cutinPortraitBottomMargin || 40)) + Number(cfg.cutinPortraitYOffset || 0);


  overlay.addChild(portrait);

  overlay.sortChildren();


  try {

    if (globalThis.Sequence && params.cutinSfx) {

      new Sequence()

        .sound()

        .file(params.cutinSfx)

        .volume(Number(cfg.cutinSfxVolume || 0.9))

        .play();

    }

  } catch (_) {}


  await waitMs(Number(cfg.cutinFlashDelayMs) || 0);


  const flashOut = (async () => {


await fadeAlpha(flash, 0, Number(cfg.cutinFlashPeak || 0.92), cfg.cutinFlashInMs, easeOutCubic);


await fadeAlpha(flash, flash.alpha, 0, cfg.cutinFlashOutMs, easeOutCubic);


})();


await tweenXY(


portrait,


portrait.x,


Number(cfg.cutinPortraitInsetX || 220),


portrait.y,


portrait.y,


cfg.cutinSlideInMs,


easeOutCubic


);


await flashOut;


await waitMs(Number(cfg.cutinHoldMs) || 0);


await tweenXY(


portrait,


portrait.x,


W + 60,


portrait.y,


portrait.y,


cfg.cutinSlideOutMs,


easeInOutCubic


);


safeRemove(overlay);


overlay.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });


}


async function playVfxAt(x, y) {


const tex = await loadTex(params.vfxFile);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = Number(x) + Number(cfg.vfxOffsetX || 0);


sprite.y = Number(y) + Number(cfg.vfxOffsetY || 0);


sprite.rotation = degToRad(Number(cfg.vfxRotationDeg || 45));


sprite.scale.set(Number(cfg.vfxScale || 1));


sprite.alpha = 1;


addStageChild(sprite, cfg.vfxZ);


try {


if (globalThis.Sequence && params.vfxSfx) {


new Sequence()


.sound()


.file(params.vfxSfx)


.volume(Number(cfg.vfxSfxVolume || 0.9))


.play();


}


} catch (_) {}


const video = sprite.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;


let ttl = Number(cfg.vfxTtlMs || 1000);


try {


if (video) {


video.currentTime = 0;


video.loop = false;


await video.play?.().catch(() => {});


if (Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0) {


ttl = Math.ceil(video.duration * 1000);


}


}


} catch (_) {}


await waitMs(ttl);


return sprite;


}


let blackOverlay;


let whiteOverlay;


let afterimageLayer;


let casterSprite;


let vfxSprite;


const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;


const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;


const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;


try {


blackOverlay = new PIXI.Graphics();


blackOverlay.beginFill(0x000000, 1);


blackOverlay.drawRect(0, 0, canvas.app.renderer.screen.width, canvas.app.renderer.screen.height);


blackOverlay.endFill();


blackOverlay.alpha = 1;


addStageChild(blackOverlay, cfg.blackZ);


afterimageLayer = addStageChild(new PIXI.Container(), cfg.afterimageZ);


casterSprite = await createCasterClone(casterToken);


addStageChild(casterSprite, cfg.spriteZ);


if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;


casterToken.visible = false;


const startX = casterSprite.x;

const startY = casterSprite.y;

const endX = Number(cfg.jumpTargetX);

const endY = Number(cfg.jumpTargetY);


const startRot = Number(casterSprite.rotation) || 0;


// Force the somersault to end upright by using a whole number of turns.

// If cfg.spinTurns is 1.5, this will round to 2.

const fullTurns = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(cfg.spinTurns || 1.5)));

const totalRot = degToRad(360 * fullTurns);


const firstTarget = Array.isArray(targetTokens) && targetTokens.length ? targetTokens[0] : null;

const absScaleX = Math.abs(Number(casterSprite.scale.x) || 1);

const landingFacingSign = resolveLandingFacingSign(firstTarget, startX, endX, casterSprite.scale.x);


let lastAfter = 0;


await tweenXY(

  casterSprite,

  startX,

  endX,

  startY,

  endY,

  cfg.jumpMs,

  easeInOutCubic,

  ({ t }) => {

    const eased = easeInOutCubic(t);

    const arc = -4 * Number(cfg.jumpArcPx || 220) * t * (1 - t);


    casterSprite.x = lerp(startX, endX, eased);

    casterSprite.y = lerp(startY, endY, eased) + arc;

    casterSprite.rotation = startRot + totalRot * eased;


    const now = performance.now();

    if (now - lastAfter >= Number(cfg.afterimageIntervalMs || 35)) {

      lastAfter = now;

      spawnAfterimageFrom(casterSprite, afterimageLayer);

    }

  }

);


// Land upright, then face the target correctly by flipping horizontally if needed.

casterSprite.rotation = startRot;

casterSprite.scale.x = absScaleX * landingFacingSign;


await playCutIn(params.cutinUrl || "");


vfxSprite = await playVfxAt(casterSprite.x, casterSprite.y);


whiteOverlay = new PIXI.Graphics();


whiteOverlay.beginFill(0xFFFFFF, 1);


whiteOverlay.drawRect(0, 0, canvas.app.renderer.screen.width, canvas.app.renderer.screen.height);


whiteOverlay.endFill();


whiteOverlay.alpha = 0;


addStageChild(whiteOverlay, cfg.whiteZ);


await fadeAlpha(whiteOverlay, 0, 1, cfg.whiteoutInMs, easeInOutCubic);


safeRemove(vfxSprite);


safeDestroy(vfxSprite);


safeRemove(casterSprite);


safeDestroy(casterSprite);


safeRemove(afterimageLayer);


safeDestroy(afterimageLayer);


safeRemove(blackOverlay);


safeDestroy(blackOverlay);


if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;


casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;


await fadeAlpha(whiteOverlay, 1, 0, cfg.whiteoutOutMs, easeInOutCubic);


safeRemove(whiteOverlay);


safeDestroy(whiteOverlay);


Hooks.callAll(params.doneHook, { ok: true });


} catch (err) {


console.error("[ONI][Anim][ApexArrow][Pseudo]", err);


try {


if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;


casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;


} catch (_) {}


safeRemove(vfxSprite); safeDestroy(vfxSprite);


safeRemove(casterSprite); safeDestroy(casterSprite);


safeRemove(afterimageLayer); safeDestroy(afterimageLayer);


safeRemove(blackOverlay); safeDestroy(blackOverlay);


safeRemove(whiteOverlay); safeDestroy(whiteOverlay);


Hooks.callAll(params.doneHook, { ok: false, error: String(err?.message || err) });


}


`;


try {


ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", payloadForEmit, { local: true, world: false });


const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);


await game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId: ANIM_KEY,


scriptSource,


casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,


targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),


params: {


actionName: ACTION_NAME,


doneHook,


cutinUrl,


vfxFile: CFG.vfxFile,


vfxSfx: CFG.vfxSfx,


cfg: CFG


},


meta: { source: ACTION_NAME }


});


const result = await waitDone;


if (!result?.ok) {


console.warn(TAG, "Pseudo animation reported a non-OK result", result);


}


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed", err);


} finally {


ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {


...payloadForEmit,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


}


})();
props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][Apex Arrow]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.log(TAG, "No target found. Skipping Apex Arrow logic.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve first target actor.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

}

/* ----------------------------------------- */

/* 1) EXECUTE */

/* Deals 200% damage to targets in Crisis */

/* ----------------------------------------- */

const CRISIS_EFFECT_ID = "5jkr80zqdzaR003d";

const crisisEffect =

targetActor.effects?.find(e => String(e?.id ?? e?._id ?? "") === CRISIS_EFFECT_ID) ??

targetActor.effects?.find(e => e?.name === "Crisis");

if (crisisEffect) {

const beforeMult = Number(p.advPayload.multiplier ?? 100) || 100;

const afterMult = beforeMult * 2;

p.advPayload.multiplier = afterMult;

p.meta.apexArrowExecute = true;

p.meta.apexArrowExecuteTargetUuid = firstTargetUuid;

context.log("Execute applied", {

target: targetActor?.name,

effectMatched: crisisEffect?.name ?? crisisEffect?.id ?? null,

multiplierBefore: beforeMult,

multiplierAfter: afterMult

});

} else {

context.log("Execute skipped - target is not in Crisis", {

target: targetActor?.name

});

}

/* ----------------------------------------- */

/* 2) DEADLY MARKSMANSHIP */

/* Apply after Execute is calculated */

/* ----------------------------------------- */

const DEADLY_TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DEADLY-MARKSMANSHIP]";

// Read final action accuracy total AFTER other accuracy bonuses

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

// Read target defense from defense snapshot first, actor data as fallback

const getDef = (targetUuid, actor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? actor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const targetDef = getDef(firstTargetUuid, targetActor);

// Bonus damage = positive difference only

const deadlyBonus = Number.isFinite(accTotal)

? Math.max(0, accTotal - targetDef)

: 0;

const bonusBefore = Number(p?.advPayload?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const bonusAfter = bonusBefore + deadlyBonus;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusAfter;

p.meta.deadlyMarksmanshipDebug = {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

};

context.log("Deadly Marksmanship applied", {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

});
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][Apex Arrow]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID.");

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const casterActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!casterActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const EFFECT_NAME = "Apex Arrow";

const EFFECT_ICON = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Skill%20Icon/FFXIVIcons%20Battle(PvE)/11_BRD/apex_arrow.png";

// Remove older copy first so the buff refreshes cleanly

const existing = casterActor.effects.filter(e => e.name === EFFECT_NAME);

for (const eff of existing) {

await eff.delete();

}

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

const currentRound = Number(combat?.round ?? 0) || 0;

// It should remain for:

// - the rest of the current round

// - the whole next round

// and disappear at the END of next round,

// which means removal when the combat advances past currentRound + 1.

const expireAfterRound = currentRound + 1;

const effectData = {

name: EFFECT_NAME,

img: EFFECT_ICON,

description: "Gaining significant Accuracy increase",

disabled: false,

changes: [

{

key: "attack_accuracy_mod_all",

mode: CONST.ACTIVE_EFFECT_MODES.ADD,

value: "5",

priority: 1

}

],

duration: combat

? {

startRound: currentRound,

rounds: 2

}

: {},

flags: {

world: {

apexArrowBuff: true,

expireCombatId: combat?.id ?? null,

expireAfterRound

}

}

};

const [effect] = await casterActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

console.log(TAG, "Apex Arrow buff created.", {

caster: casterActor?.name,

effectId: effect?.id,

combatId: combat?.id ?? null,

currentRound,

expireAfterRound

});

// Cleanup old hook for this actor/skill if one exists

globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore ??= {};

const hookKey = `${casterActor.id}:ApexArrow`;

const oldHookId = globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

if (oldHookId != null) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", oldHookId);

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

// Reliable expiration in combat

if (combat) {

const sourceCombatId = combat.id;

const sourceActorId = casterActor.id;

const sourceEffectId = effect.id;

const hookId = Hooks.on("updateCombat", async (updatedCombat, changed) => {

if (updatedCombat?.id !== sourceCombatId) return;

if (changed.round === undefined) return;

const liveActor = game.actors.get(sourceActorId);

if (!liveActor) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

return;

}

const liveEffect =

liveActor.effects.get(sourceEffectId) ??

liveActor.effects.find(e => e.name === EFFECT_NAME);

if (!liveEffect) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

return;

}

const newRound = Number(updatedCombat?.round ?? 0) || 0;

// Remove at the start of the round AFTER next round,

// which is effectively the end of next round.

if (newRound <= expireAfterRound) return;

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

await liveEffect.delete();

console.log(TAG, "Apex Arrow buff expired.", {

caster: liveActor?.name,

removedAtRound: newRound,

intendedExpireAfterRound: expireAfterRound

});

});

globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey] = hookId;

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "No active combat found. Buff created, but timed expiry hook was not attached.");

}
